children: Mexico's industrial production likely had a slow start to 3Q, with output seen slipping in July from the previous month but above the year-earlier level. Industrial production is seen down 0.1% from June in seasonally adjusted terms, according to a WSJ survey of analysts. Industrial output is expected to be up 1.7% unadjusted from July of 2025. National statistics institute Inegi is scheduled to report July industrial production on Friday. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
